properties.description: Five handler-level pins: get_skill carries the lessons naming that skill and no other; the tool list carries a lesson on its tool and nowhere else; a no-step lesson is kept and delivered nowhere; an unserved step is refused with the nearest names and nothing written; rules take steps and the newest lesson comes first. Shown to fail on the deliver-everything-everywhere mutation (2 pins).
